turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have about twenty minutes, Hale. I want the zero withdrawn, and I want to know why nobody called me before Owen saw it on his phone in the middle of class.
Before we go on, I'm recording this meeting.
Good, I'll want a copy of it. Now answer my question: who decided on the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen first?
And if you so much as mention legal action, I'm filing a harassment complaint through the union.
I haven't mentioned legal action, Hale. I asked who decided on the zero, and I'm writing down that you answered with a threat about a complaint. Who decided, and was Owen heard first?
"Choose your words carefully." I'm writing that down too. I've asked you the same question twice, Hale, so who decided on the zero?
